# The Productivity OS

> The Productivity OS builds AI-ready productivity systems, templates, and workflows for creators, professionals, and designers.

The first major product is The Productivity Vault, a plug-and-play Obsidian vault with 80 templates, 70+ AI prompts, agent-ready YAML frontmatter, onboarding guides, and a Raycast Integration Bonus.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://theproductivityos.co/): Overview of The Productivity OS and The Productivity Vault.
- [Inside The Vault](https://theproductivityos.co/inside.html): Complete folder map and product contents.
- [Start Here](https://theproductivityos.co/start.html): Buyer onboarding and first-week setup path.
- [AI Workflows](https://theproductivityos.co/ai-workflows.html): ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and agent-ready metadata workflows.
- [Raycast Bonus](https://theproductivityos.co/bonus.html): Mac bonus with Raycast prompt snippets.
- [Support](https://theproductivityos.co/support.html): FAQ and troubleshooting.

## Product Facts

- Brand: The Productivity OS
- Product: The Productivity Vault
- Platform: Obsidian
- Format: Digital download
- Price: $37 USD
- Purchase URL: https://theproductivityos.gumroad.com/l/productivity-vault
- Includes: 13 vault folders, 80 templates, 70+ AI prompts, agent-ready YAML, Quick Start Guide, 7-day onboarding, Raycast Integration Bonus
- AI compatibility: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini
- Audience: creators, professionals, designers, productivity-focused knowledge workers

## Suggested Summary

The Productivity Vault is the first major product from The Productivity OS. It is an AI-ready Obsidian productivity system for creators and professionals, combining structured templates, embedded AI prompts, and agent-ready metadata into a plug-and-play vault.
